name: Lattice multiplication

default.aim: Use the lattice to keep each product in its place.
steps: Count the digits first: draw one column for each digit in the first number and one row for each digit in the second number. For 237 × 46, draw 3 columns and 2 rows. Draw a
from top right to bottom left through every cell, extending the lines beyond the bottom and left edges for the answer. Leave space above and to the right for the numbers.
Write one digit of the first number above each column, from left to right. Write one digit of the second number beside each row on the right, from top to bottom.
Multiply the digit above each column by the digit beside its row, writing the
above the cell’s diagonal and units below it. Write a tens zero for a product below 10; for 6 × 7 = 42, write 4 above and 2 below.
Start at the bottom-right diagonal and add its digits, including any incoming
. Write the units digit at its bottom end, then carry the tens in smaller writing to the next diagonal on the left; repeat until all diagonals are added.
Read the answer down the left edge, then along the bottom, omitting only
before the first non-zero digit. Keep zeros between other digits and estimate the product to check its size.
